messages:
ashley: Heads up — I noticed ~2% of invoice previews have negative line items this morning when route-tag is missing. Started after the consumer-handshake deploy at 03:10 UTC. Anyone else seeing this?

devon: saw a couple in the nightly run, wasn't sure if they were late-arrivals or a dup. do you have a sample event id?

ashley: yeah pasting one (sanitized):
```json
{"tenant_id":"t-123","event_id":"evt-9ab","usage":-12,"route_tags":[],"ingest_ts":"2025-10-12T03:11:02Z"}
```

kai: negative usage is odd. looks like ledger merge logic treats missing route_tag as default discount path and subtracts credits. that default path only exists in the old handshake flow. Did the consumer change the handshake payload?

ashley: consumer did change to `handshake_v2` last night (rollout flagged to 10%). handshake_v2 omits `route_tag` when it's empty. previous consumer sent `route_tag: null`.

sophia: ah — our aggregation join uses `COALESCE(route_tag, 'unassigned')` at ingest, but the connector that emits to preview uses `if (route_tag) emitTag() else skipTag()` which means the downstream preview service sees `[]` not `null`. ledger's billing transform has an old rule: `if route_tag == '' then apply_reseller_discount()` — that would flip sign if usage is negative after promo adjustments.

devon: so it's a three-way mismatch: connector -> aggregator -> ledger. aggregator expects `null` vs `[]` vs `''`. we should normalize at the ingest boundary to a canonical sentinel.

metering-bot: Automated check: ingest-normalizer health 98.6% up; 12 events/hour with `route_tags: []` in last 2h. Linking dashboard: https://console.internal/ingest/normalizer/alerts :rotating_light:

kai: quick mitigation: ledger transform PR ready to treat empty arrays as `unassigned` instead of triggering discount. can hotfix and then revert once consumers converge.

ashley: +1 to hotfix. but we need a plan so we don't reintroduce other edge-cases. checklist: 1) hotfix ledger to treat `[]` as unassigned (safe fallback), 2) patch ingest-normalizer to rewrite `[]` -> `null` (canonical), 3) add rollout gauge in console to flag `route_tag` schema mismatches.

sophia: I'll own (2) and (3). can add a small sampling time-series: `ingest.route_tag_type` with buckets (`null`, `array`, `string`) and set an alert if `array` > 0.5% of 5m window.

devon: I'll cut the ledger hotfix PR and ship a canary to staging+canary. will annotate the invoice-preview to ignore historic previews until fix.

ops-bot: deploy request queued by devon for `ledger-transform@hotfix/route-array-fallback` — CI: ✅ , canary: pending.

ashley: thanks. also let's add a one-off backfill to scan previews for negative lines and mark them as pending until ledger fix lands so customers don't get billed incorrectly.

kai: agreed. will write backfill query and run with dry-run first.

ashley: filing a short postmortem note and linking threads. FYI — we should add a small entry to the rollout playbook: "schema-variance check for handshake changes". :memo:

metering-bot: Postmortem draft created: https://docs.internal/postmortems/pm-2025-10-12-route-tag-schema-gap — assigned to ashley/sophia/devon.

ashley: cool. I'll update the invoice-preview UX to show an explanatory banner for any previews affected by edge-case normalization. will ping once patch is live. :thumbsup:
